data.value: Will the residents' petition against the Riverton quarry extension collect the 1,500 signatures needed to trigger a council debate before the submission deadline in six weeks?

The town of Riverton has 19,000 residents. The quarry employs 85 residents. A petition against the quarry extension is being circulated. Organizers have collected 400 signatures in the first fortnight. The submission deadline is in six weeks from the start date (2026-08-03), i.e., by 2026-09-14. A counter-flyer from the quarry operator appeared last week.
